tools.name: search_fonts
tools.description: Search the free font catalog by name, category, style tags, language coverage, variable/monospace flags and style count. Returns a paginated list of families.

tools.name: recognize_font
tools.description: Identify which font is used in an image. Powered by our OWN CNN embedding model, trained on the jinero font catalog — it matches fonts by visual shape/style, so it needs NO OCR and NO text (works for Latin and Cyrillic). Send a tight crop of one line of text as either image_url (public URL) or image

tools.name: get_font
tools.description: Get full metadata for one font family by slug: styles, weights, axes, license, subsets and download/CSS URLs.

tools.name: get_font_files
tools.description: List every font file (weight/italic/format + direct woff2/ttf URL) for a family — handy for building custom @font-face rules.

tools.name: get_fonts_css
tools.description: Generate ready-to-use @font-face CSS for a family spec (Google-Fonts-compatible), e.g. "inter:wght@400,700" or a variable range "inter:wght@300..900". Returns CSS text.

tools.name: get_font_download_url
tools.description: Return the direct ZIP download URL for a font family (all styles + a ready fonts.css). Does NOT download — hand the URL to the user or fetch it separately.

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.description: Check the WCAG contrast ratio between a foreground and background color, with AA/AAA pass/fail for normal and large text.

tools.name: get_color_shades
tools.description: Generate tints and shades for a base color (lighter/darker steps) with hex values.

tools.name: name_color
tools.description: Get the closest human-readable name for one or more colors. Pass a single hex or several comma-separated (e.g. "#3b82f6,#000,#ff7f50"); returns each input with its nearest color name, the reference hex, an exact-match flag and the perceptual distance.

tools.name: extract_colors
tools.description: Extract a dominant-color palette from an image. Send either a public image_url or image_base64 (base64/data-URI, e.g. a local screenshot). The image is processed in memory and never stored. Each color comes back with its hex, rgb, hsl, share of the image, and the closest human color name — a named p

tools.name: search_palettes
tools.description: Search the color-palette catalog by name, tone, temperature, mood, harmony, exact color count and tags. Returns a paginated list.

tools.name: get_palette
tools.description: Get one color palette by id: its colors (hex), name/derived title, mood, harmony, temperature and tags.

tools.name: minify_code
tools.description: Minify or beautify JS, CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON or XML text. Set type=auto to sniff the language. The code is only parsed and re-printed — never executed and never stored. Rate limit: 30 calls/min per IP.

tools.name: detect_code
tools.description: Detect the language/format of a code snippet. Static analysis only — the snippet is never executed and never stored.

tools.name: convert_code
tools.description: Convert code between text formats (e.g. JSON↔YAML, CSS↔SCSS). Pure text transformation: the source is parsed and re-serialized, never executed and never stored. Use list_code_converters for valid from/to ids and per-converter options. Rate limit: 30 calls/min per IP.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "recognize_font" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Identify which font is used in an image. Powered by our OWN CNN embedding model, trained on the jinero font catalog — it matches fonts by visual shape/style, so…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_font, get_font_files, get_font_download_url · Private data: get_font_files · Public sink: recognize_font, extract_colors · Destructive: get_font_files, detect_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_font, get_font_files, get_font_download_url · Private data: get_font_files · Public sink: recognize_font, extract_colors · Destructive: get_font_files, detect_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "extract_colors" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Extract a dominant-color palette from an image URL. Each color comes back with its hex, rgb, hsl, share of the image, and the closest human color name — a named palette in one call." → after: "Extract a dominant-color palette from an image. Send either a public image_url or image_base64 (base64/data-URI, e.g. a local screenshot). The image is processed in memory and never stored. Each color comes back with its hex, rgb, hsl, share of the image, and the closest human color name — a named p"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
